data.body:
## rebar-debug final report — RESOLVED, merged as 2f232a9d8e

**Gerrit:** https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1495 — LLM-Review +1, Verified +1,
submitted, MERGED.

**Proven root cause.** See the RCA comment above for the full mechanism and the three-run
runtime table. In one line: the `__path__` compensation for the `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler`
package shadow is installed in `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conftest.py` — one directory deeper
than the directory whose collection creates the shadow (`tests/unit`, put at `sys.path[0]` by
pytest's prepend import mode for ANY `tests/unit/**` module).

**Test.** `tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py::test_engine_submodules_resolve_when_the_tests_unit_shadow_is_active`.
Subprocess-based and deliberately selecting a `tests/unit` module OUTSIDE `rebar_reconciler/` —
an in-process assertion is masked, because any full-suite run collects
`tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/**` and therefore fires that directory's own compensation, so the
invariant would hold even with the fix fully reverted (measured). Same masking hazard and same
subprocess remedy as the packaging guard already in that file. Confirmed RED for the right
reason before any fix existed, held out from the fix subagent (moved out of its tree, path
declared off-limits), GREEN after. Mutation check: deleting the `_bridge_reconciler_shadow_package()`
call returned it to RED; restoring returned it to GREEN.

**Fix.** `tests/unit/conftest.py` (+61, test-only; no production code). Hoists the compensation
to where the shadow can exist. The shadow package is seeded *explicitly* from its own
`__init__.py` via `spec_from_file_location(..., submodule_search_locations=...)` rather than by a
plain `import`, so the bridge does not depend on what `sys.path[0]` happens to be — the proven
trap (a plain `import` placed after the engine `sys.path` insert binds the ENGINE package first,
makes `__path__.append` a no-op, and breaks `rebar_reconciler.conftest` resolution outright) is
structurally defused, not merely avoided by ordering. I verified this: moving the bridge call
after the `sys.path` insert leaves both `pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_lock_steal.py`
and the guard green. The engine dir is *appended*, not prepended, preserving object identity of
pre-seeded flat `rebar_reconciler.<name>` keys. The deeper compensation was left in place — it is
idempotent and now simply finds the engine dir already present.

**Scope & safety.** Caller-dependency sweep: the only behavioural dependants of `rebar_reconciler`
binding are the tests under `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` — 2288 pass unchanged. The change
restores an existing compensation at the correct scope rather than creating behaviour, adds no
dependency, and weakens no test (the diff is purely additive: +61 conftest, +67 new guard).
`make lint` and `make typecheck` clean; full unit suite 8757 passed.

**Siblings.**
- *Construct axis:* the class is "a test directory that shadows a real top-level package".
  Swept: exactly four package directories exist under `tests/`
  (`tests/unit/{grounding,metrics,rebar_reconciler,workflow}`), and intersecting their basenames
  with the top-level names importable from the engine dir (`rebar_reconciler`, `resources`,
  `jira-capability-probe`) leaves `rebar_reconciler` as the only shadow. `grounding` / `metrics`
  / `workflow` shadow nothing — no top-level `import grounding|metrics|workflow` exists anywhere
  in `src`, `tests`, or `scripts`. `tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/` has no `__init__.py`, so
  it is not a package and creates no shadow. No siblings to fix.
- *Parity axis:* the rule is "an engine module exec'd standalone must be able to resolve its
  `rebar_reconciler.<sub>` dependencies in any session where the shadow exists". Channel census —
  `tests/unit` conftest: now holds it (the fix); `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler` conftest: holds it
  (`:75-77`); `tests/scripts` conftest: N/A (creates no shadow — it only inserts the engine dir);
  `tests/integration/rebar_reconciler` conftest: N/A (directory is not a package). No MISSING
  slots.

**Residual risk.** The compensation is now written out three times (the hoisted bridge plus two
older inline copies at `tests/unit/test_canonical_consolidation.py:66-67` and
`tests/unit/test_code_review_artifact.py:118-119`, each of which is itself a fingerprint of this
same defect — two prior authors hit the shadow from a top-level `tests/unit` module and patched
locally). All are idempotent and harmless, so removing them was deliberately left out of this
change's diff. Disposition: **ticket filed** — [rebar:8120-6d1c-58cb-4473], linked
`discovered_from` this bug.

**Replication.** The report's own commands, on the merged tree:
`pytest tests/interfaces/queries tests/unit/<any> tests/scripts/reducer tests/scripts/graph -q -p no:randomly`
-> **445 passed, 1 skipped, 0 errors** (was 444 passed + 1 ERROR). The clean baseline selection
without `tests/unit` is unchanged, and `pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler` remains 2288 passed.
